entries.label: Workspace gates: fmt, shell syntax, book links, cargo deny, host+wasm clippy, boundaries
command:
set -euo pipefail
cargo fmt --all --check
bash -n scripts/build-pages-site.sh
bash scripts/check-book-links.sh
cargo deny check
cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo clippy --locked -p physician-app -p duet-app -p mobile -p ui-gallery -p extension-popup --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features physician-app/web,duet-app/web,mobile/web,ui-gallery/web,extension-popup/web -- -D warnings
cargo test --locked -p boundaries

entries.label: HTTP ingress guard and dabney.moe retargeting: coda-http, duet-api, physician-sample, public-site (incl. Chromium export E2E)
command:
set -euo pipefail
cargo test --locked -p coda-http
cargo test --locked -p duet-api --lib
cargo test --locked -p physician-sample --lib
cargo test --locked -p public-site --lib --tests
cargo test --locked -p public-site --test site -- --ignored
